_note: Solo shared-infra trains (operator 2026-10-25: "fully done, fully automatic, no input by me, for the train systems unless there's an issue"). Read by scripts/lib/release_train_solo.py. A needs_operator PR rides ALONE (exactly one member, never mixed with eligible PRs) when AGENTS.md 20.4.0 is ACTIVE and every condition holds: title starts with title_prefix; the required_check is success on the exact head SHA (trusted app, latest run); the body has a 'Real-layout proof:' line; a PR comment carries 'Adversarial-review: MERGE reviewer=<ref> head=<sha> coordinator=<session>' whose head is the PR head and whose session holds a coordinator claim (coordination/COORDINATOR) on the agent claim board; EVERY changed path matches allow_globs; NO changed path matches deny_globs or a deny_policy_rules rule of config/release_train_policy.json; no classifier reason names a deny_reason_rules rule; and the classifier's overall class is exactly needs_operator (held / blocked never ride). DENY ALWAYS WINS. This file is train-self (blocked): it changes only through the manual release.
precedence_note: batch_first: in a window where at least one eligible PR is ready, the eligible batch goes and the solo candidate waits (its reason is SOLO_DEFERRED_BATCH_FIRST); a window with no eligible batch carries exactly one solo candidate, chosen by the batch queue order (operator next-batch first, then lowest PR number). Mixed trains never form. solo_first is the only other accepted value.
